أستوطئ (form X)
# أَسْتَوْطِئُ (ʔastawṭiʔu) /ʔas.taw.tˤi.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
# أَسْتَوْطِئَ (ʔastawṭiʔa) /ʔas.taw.tˤi.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
# أَسْتَوْطِئْ (ʔastawṭiʔ) /ʔas.taw.tˤiʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
